name: auto-tag
title: AutoTag
description: Tag and category suggestions constrained to the app's own list, fuzzy-matched after the model answers.

import { z } from 'zod'

export const tagsSchema = (tags: readonly string[]) => z.object({ tags: z.array(tags.length ? z.enum(tags as [string, ...string[]]) : z.string()).max(8) })

export { AutoTag, type AutoTagProps } from './auto-tag'
export { useAutoTag, type AutoTagState, type UseAutoTagOptions } from './use-auto-tag'
export { autoTagInstructions } from './prompts'
export { tagsSchema } from './schema'

budget.strategy: One structured call with an enum-constrained array; results fuzzy-matched to the list.
